text:
Maya: We just crossed 250k MAU this morning 🎉🥳. Cake in the kitchen at 3pm — come grab a slice and a quick toast? @here
Aj: OMG YES. bringing confetti poppers? :grin:
Devin: amazing work team. can we get a GF option pls? allergies etc.
Sam: ordering a small GF tray + some coffee. will drop in at 2:45 to set up.
Leah (she/her): quick idea — for this milestone let's do a small donation: plant 250 trees or donate $250 to the community ML fund. who’s in? :seedling:
Maya: love that. let's do a poll in the thread and mark votes by emoji. planning to do both internally (team lunch) + donate if OK with leadership.
Aj: vote ✅ for trees. will add a sticky on the org board.
Devin: vote 🌍 for community ML fund (would be great for scholarships).
Sam: vote ✅ (trees) — and yes to coffee + cupcakes.
ops-bot: deploy-notify: production rollout completed at 10:12AM — no errors detected. :white_check_mark:
Maya: huge shoutout to infra + runtime teams — the rollout window didn't wobble despite a big traffic spike this morning. objective win.
Leah (she/her): shoutout emoji train 🚂: Maya, Sam, Aj, Devin, infra team. so proud.
Aj: also, low-key request: can someone post a photo of the cake? remote folks deserve FOMO. :camera_with_flash:
Sam: will do. tagging @remote-coworkers later in the thread with a cake pic.
Devin: can we squeeze a 10-minute lightning share at 3:15? two people, one slide each, about a fun part of this launch.
Maya: yes — love that. sign up with a reaction (✋) and I'll collect names.
Aj: ✋
Devin: ✋
Leah (she/her): ✋
Maya: ok cool — final logistics: kitchen @ 3pm, 3:05 quick toast, 3:15 lightning shares, 3:30 cake-free-for-all. remote folks, I'll post pics and a five-minute recording clip.
ops-bot: reminder: office kitchen cleaning scheduled at 4:30PM. please clear plates by 4:15.
Sam: picture incoming in 5!
Maya: THANK YOU everyone. huge milestone. let's keep the momentum going. :rocket:
